parent_objective: materialize no-rollout off-track repair panel from localized target slices
blocked_by: need no-rollout repair panel preflight before any execution design
supersedes: direct repair panel execution after M1720

public_gates: M1721 must materialize a no-rollout repair panel from M1720 design
M1721 must select 18 base specs with T4=12 and T5=6 if eligible target sources exist
M1721 must keep four variants per base spec including wide_relaxed_extended
M1721 must keep all twelve controller-family profiles as controls
M1721 must not run rollout train replay PPO promote use private holdout or change actor inputs
M1721 must not claim controller-family ranking, paper-level evidence, or level3 self-ID

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: materializes no-rollout repair panel metadata before execution design
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: metadata preflight only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if eligible target sources cannot supply T4=12 and T5=6
stop if wide_relaxed_extended is missing for any selected base spec
stop if any selected row violates P0 actor contract
stop if profile controls are incomplete
fallback_plan: route to source-distribution redesign if target sources are insufficient
route to artifact repair if calibration matrix lookup fails
route to preflight audit if materialization passes
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1720 admits no-rollout repair panel preflight

admission_evidence: M1720 designs a fixed-budget repair panel and blocks direct rollout
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1721 status queue scoreboard research log and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1721 materializes task repair metadata and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: preflight must keep L1, L2-current-tiled, L3-online, and L3-reset controls in the repair panel
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If repair panel preflight cannot be materialized, route to source-distribution redesign rather than weakening self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no rollout, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The M1720 repair panel can be materialized as clean no-rollout metadata with 18 base specs, four variants, and all twelve profiles.
success_criteria: variant labels include original_axis_baseline best_off_track_variant collision_control_wide_relaxed wide_relaxed_extended
training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: selected base specs are fewer than 18
task-family split cannot satisfy T4=12 T5=6
environment rollout training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur
decision_rule: M1721 passes if it materializes the no-rollout repair panel exactly and keeps guardrails clean.
